description: This file defines functions to generate kernel command line parameters based on configuration and instance-specific settings for the Cuttlefish virtual machine environment. It includes logic for different architectures and VM modes, and handles external kernel parameters and console/serial configurations.

methods.name: AppendVector
methods.description: Template function to append elements from source vector to destination vector.

methods.name: VmManagerKernelCmdline
methods.description: Generates a vector of kernel command line parameters based on VM mode, architecture, and instance settings.

methods.name: KernelCommandLineFromConfig
methods.description: Combines VM-specific kernel command line parameters with extra kernel command line options from the configuration.
